speaker: 家豪
source_cantonese: 詠思，你將來想做乜嘢工作呀？
source_jyutping: /wing6 si1, nei5 zoeng1 loi4 soeng2 zou6 mat1 je5 gung1 zok3 aa3?/

speaker: 詠思
source_jyutping: /ngo5 dou1 m4 hai6 hou2 hang2 ding6. nei5 ne1?/

speaker: 家豪
source_jyutping: /ngo5 soeng2 zou6 lou5 si1, gaau3 siu2 pang4 jau5./

speaker: 詠思
source_jyutping: /waa3, zou6 lou5 si1 hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3 wo3!/

speaker: 家豪
source_cantonese: 係辛苦，但係我鍾意同小朋友相處。
source_jyutping: /hai6 san1 fu2, daan6 hai6 ngo5 zung1 ji3 tung4 siu2 pang4 jau5 soeng1 cyu5./

speaker: 詠思
source_jyutping: /gam2 nei5 duk6 gan2 gaau3 juk6 laa1?/

speaker: 家豪
source_cantonese: 係呀，我讀緊教育學位課程。
source_jyutping: /hai6 aa3, ngo5 duk6 gan2 gaau3 juk6 hok6 wai2 fo3 cing4./

speaker: 詠思
source_jyutping: /zung6 jau5 gei2 do1 nin4 sin1 bat1 jip6 aa3?/

speaker: 家豪
source_cantonese: 仲有兩年。你呢？你想做咩？
source_jyutping: /zung6 jau5 loeng5 nin4. nei5 ne1? nei5 soeng2 zou6 me1?/

speaker: 詠思
source_cantonese: 我鍾意畫畫，想做設計師。
source_jyutping: /ngo5 zung1 ji3 waak6 waa2, soeng2 zou6 cit3 gai3 si1./

speaker: 詠思
source_jyutping: /mei6 aa3, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 duk6 gan2 soeng1 fo1./

speaker: 家豪
source_jyutping: /dim2 gaai2 m4 duk6 cit3 gai3 aa3?/

speaker: 詠思
source_cantonese: 我屋企人話商科搵食容易啲。
source_jyutping: /ngo5 uk1 kei2 jan4 waa6 soeng1 fo1 wan2 sik6 jung4 ji6 di1./

speaker: 家豪
source_cantonese: 但係你真係鍾意商科咩？
source_jyutping: /daan6 hai6 nei5 zan1 hai6 zung1 ji3 soeng1 fo1 me1?/

speaker: 詠思
source_jyutping: /m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3, gok3 dak1 hou2 mun6./

speaker: 家豪
source_jyutping: /gam2 nei5 ho2 ji5 zyun2 fo1 aa3!/

speaker: 詠思
source_cantonese: 我都有諗過，但係驚屋企人嬲。
source_jyutping: /ngo5 dou1 jau5 nam2 gwo3, daan6 hai6 geng1 uk1 kei2 jan4 nau1./

speaker: 家豪
source_cantonese: 你要做自己鍾意嘅嘢先開心㗎。
source_jyutping: /nei5 jiu3 zou6 zi6 gei2 zung1 ji3 ge3 je5 sin1 hoi1 sam1 gaa3./

speaker: 詠思
source_cantonese: 你講得啱。我應該同屋企人傾吓。
source_jyutping: /nei5 gong2 dak1 ngaam1. ngo5 jing1 goi1 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 king1 haa5./

speaker: 家豪
source_cantonese: 係呀！你將來想做設計，而家就要準備。
source_jyutping: /hai6 aa3! nei5 zoeng1 loi4 soeng2 zou6 cit3 gai3, ji4 gaa1 zau6 jiu3 zeon2 bei6./

speaker: 詠思
source_cantonese: 我可以平時自己學畫畫。
source_jyutping: /ngo5 ho2 ji5 ping4 si4 zi6 gei2 hok6 waak6 waa2./

speaker: 家豪
source_jyutping: /ngaam1 aa3! nei5 jau5 mou5 soeng5 mong5 hok6?/

speaker: 詠思
source_jyutping: /jau5 aa3, ngo5 tai2 gan2 YouTube gaau3 hok6./

speaker: 家豪
source_cantonese: 好呀！慢慢學，將來一定做到設計師。
source_jyutping: /hou2 aa3! maan6 maan6 hok6, zoeng1 loi4 jat1 ding6 zou6 dou2 cit3 gai3 si1./

speaker: 詠思
source_cantonese: 希望啦！你呢？你有冇做過補習？
source_jyutping: /hei1 mong6 laa1! nei5 ne1? nei5 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 bou2 zaap6?/

speaker: 家豪
source_cantonese: 有呀！我而家幫小學生補習。
source_jyutping: /jau5 aa3! ngo5 ji4 gaa1 bong1 siu2 hok6 saang1 bou2 zaap6./

speaker: 家豪
source_cantonese: 有時難，但係好有滿足感。
source_jyutping: /jau5 si4 naan4, daan6 hai6 hou2 jau5 mun5 zuk1 gam2./

speaker: 詠思
source_jyutping: /nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sik1 hap6 zou6 lou5 si1./

speaker: 家豪
source_cantonese: 多謝！你將來做設計都一定得㗎！
source_jyutping: /do1 ze6! nei5 zoeng1 loi4 zou6 cit3 gai3 dou1 jat1 ding6 dak1 gaa3!/

speaker: 詠思
source_cantonese: 希望我哋嘅夢想都會實現。
source_jyutping: /hei1 mong6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 mung6 soeng2 dou1 wui5 sat6 jin6./

speaker: 家豪
source_cantonese: 一定會㗎！最緊要有目標。
source_jyutping: /jat1 ding6 wui5 gaa3! zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 jau5 muk6 biu1./

speaker: 詠思
source_cantonese: 我今日之後會努力啲㗎喇！
source_jyutping: /ngo5 gam1 jat6 zi1 hau6 wui5 nou5 lik6 di1 gaa3 laa3!/

speaker: 家豪
source_jyutping: /hou2 aa3! ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 gaa1 jau4!/

speaker: 詠思
source_jyutping: /nei5 gei2 si4 bat1 jip6 zau6 zou6 lou5 si1?/

speaker: 家豪
source_cantonese: 畢業之後會搵學校，希望搵到啦。
source_jyutping: /bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 wui5 wan2 hok6 haau6, hei1 mong6 wan2 dou2 laa1./

speaker: 詠思
source_jyutping: /nei5 gam3 jau5 sam1, jat1 ding6 wan2 dou2 gaa3!/

speaker: 詠思
source_jyutping: /ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 loi4 dou1 wui5 sing4 gung1 gaa3!/
